up: Retrieve all exact IC50 activity values in nM for compounds tested against the human target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL325 (Histone deacetylase 1). Return the ChEMBL ID of the compound, its canonical SMILES, the exact IC50 value in nM, and the PubMed ID or DOI of the source document. Limit results to those where the activity relation is '=' and units are 'nM'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_value AS ic50_nM, COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL325' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
